description: This source file contains unit tests for URL normalization functions, specifically testing various aspects of URL parsing and normalization such as scheme, authority, port, special character escaping, Unicode handling, username/password parsing, URL length, path segments, and URL equivalence. It extensively uses functions from 'urlmatch.h' and testing assertions from 'unit-test.h'.

methods.name: void check_url_normalizable(const char * url,unsigned int normalizable)
methods.description: Checks if a given URL is considered normalizable by the URL normalization function.

methods.name: void check_normalized_url(const char * url,const char * expect)
methods.description: Verifies that the normalized URL matches the expected string.

methods.name: void compare_normalized_urls(const char * url1,const char * url2,unsigned int equal)
methods.description: Compares two URLs after normalization for equality or inequality based on the 'equal' parameter.

methods.name: void check_normalized_url_length(const char * url,size_t len)
methods.description: Checks if the length of the normalized URL matches the expected length.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__scheme(void)
methods.description: Unit test for URL scheme normalization and validity.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__authority(void)
methods.description: Unit test for normalization and validation of URL authority component.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__port(void)
methods.description: Unit test for URL port normalization and validation.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__port_normalization(void)
methods.description: Unit test for port number normalization and URL formatting.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__general_escape(void)
methods.description: Unit test for URL normalization involving percent-encoding and escaping.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__high_bit(void)
methods.description: Unit test for normalization of URLs with high-bit characters, ensuring proper percent-encoding.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__utf8_escape(void)
methods.description: Unit test for normalization of URLs with UTF-8 multibyte characters.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__username_pass(void)
methods.description: Unit test for normalization involving username and password encoding within URLs.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__length(void)
methods.description: Unit test for checking URL length calculations after normalization.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__dots(void)
methods.description: Unit test for URL path normalization involving '.' and '..' segments.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__equivalents(void)
methods.description: Unit test for URL equivalence after normalization, including case insensitivity and default port handling.

ctags.pattern: /^static void check_url_normalizable(const char *url, unsigned int normalizable)$/
